pages.text: “Bright red petals, rich in fragrance—gentle yet carrying an untamed energy.”$(br2)Rose Tea is a highly aromatic and invigorating beverage made from dried rose petals. The tea has a soft red hue and a mildly sweet taste. Drinking it provides a strong Speed boost, making the traveler’s steps lighter and faster.

$(br2)$(br)Rose Tea is simple to prepare—$(br)blend dried rose petals with sugar to create this fragrant and energetic tea.$(br)It is best consumed during travel, allowing for quicker movement and saving valuable time.

Upon drinking Rose Tea, travelers gain a strong Speed boost, significantly increasing their walking and running speed for an extended duration.$(br)This tea is perfect for fast-paced journeys, whether advancing swiftly or making a quick escape.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
